tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti a yu dz+nyā na sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ bcol ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dang gnyis su med pa'i zhabs la bdag sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su gzung du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das 'chi med dbang po'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa la brten nas rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa spyi dang bye brag bdag la bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar du zhabs pad brtan zhing phrin las rgyas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhing mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub rgyun mi chad pa'i sgo nas bstan 'gro la phan bde dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang / yangs pa'i rgyal khams su nad mug 'khrug longs sa g.yos lce 'bab rgyal po'i chad pa sogs dus min 'chi ba dang / nyer 'tshe mtha' dag mi 'byung zhing skye rgu thams cad la mi nor rdzas gsum rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin 'phel nas dus gnas kun tu bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag sbyin pa'i bdag po bsod nams 'od zer 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/ las ngan spyi dang khyad par dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang phyug lung rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don yid bzhin du 'grub ste mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun gyi mgon skyabs su gyur nas gang 'dul sprul pas 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig i daṃ shā sa nañca satwa hi to bha wan+tu/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa gzhu lung pas bskul ngor/ sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis lcags lug gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i mar tshes gnyis la sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// //shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
